mapper.select: SELECT owner.organization_id, owner.account_id, owner.protected_role_id, account.username, COALESCE(account.display_name, account.username) AS display_name, owner.effective_time, owner.version FROM public.iam_org_owner owner JOIN public.iam_account account ON account.tenant_id=owner.tenant_id AND account.organization_id=owner.organization_id AND account.id=owner.account_id AND account.is_deleted=false WHERE owner.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND owner.is_deleted=false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_org_owner SET account_id=#{toAccountId}, effective_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND account_id=#{fromAccountId} AND version=#{version} AND is_deleted=false

UPDATE public.iam_account_role SET is_deleted=true, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND account_id=#{accountId} AND role_id=#{roleId} AND is_deleted=false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.iam_account_role (id, tenant_id, organization_id, account_id, role_id, assigned_by, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (nextval('public.iam_account_role_seq'),#{tenantId},#{organizationId},#{accountId},#{roleId}, #{operatorId},#{operatorId},#{operatorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.iam_account SET authz_version=authz_version+1, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND id=#{accountId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND is_deleted=false
